name: Cloche Leythal Pastalia
original_name: クローシェ・レーテル・パスタリエ
source:
Likes: Gergo, ugly-cute creatures, Kurukuru dumplings, Pippen, fruit waffles
Dislikes: Grotesque things, horror movies, excessively sweet foods
Singer: Akiko Shikata

Said to be the "Most Valuable Life" in the world of Metalfalss. The stateswoman who represents the Grand Bell. She is also a Reyvateil.
Behind the 33rd Holy Maiden, she is an extremely charismatic idol and superstar among all people who support the Grand Bell.
She is especially popular of all the Holy Maidens in Metalfalss' history. Her speeches are very energetic, and she empowered the people with her eloquence in this stagnant phase in human history, so she has gained enormous popularity.
However, because she was raised in the Palace and has hardly gone out, she's socially ignorant and a bit awkward around people. That is probably why she is usually pompous and sometimes even intimidating.

[From [url=http://www.nisamerica.com/games/AT2/]official site[/url]]
